title: Minimum mass, maximum charge and hyperbolicity in scalar Gauss-Bonnet gravity
summary: We study the loss of hyperbolicity of perturbation equations for black hole solutions of scalar Gauss-Bonnet gravity. We consider a class of coupling functions allowing for static black hole solutions with arbitrary small masses. For masses below a minimum value, such solutions become unphysical, because the perturbation equations become elliptic; this arguably corresponds to the loss of validity of the effective field theory.
